selectedDesign.name: CreationConsumerRouteScopedProjectionCacheV1
selectedDesign.summary: Create one existing projectionCache per fixed creation consumer route and share it across all full candidate proofs in that route.

rejectedAlternatives: Skill, role or case-specific fast paths
exactDataFlow: Build the full creation consumer candidate pool exactly as before.
Create bestHealthByUnit, behaviorPoolByIdentity and pendingNaturalActorIds once for the fixed route.
Pass the same route-local projectionCache to every supported candidate proof.
CandidateValueProof continues to bind candidate-specific facts and causal ownership after reading source-neutral cached projections.
Sort all valid proofs and select the best route exactly as before.
cacheAndInvalidationChanges: Reuse is bounded to one r9v2BestCreationConsumerRoute invocation.
withoutProduct and withProduct calls retain separate caches.
The existing behaviorPoolByIdentity remains the reuse authority.
No FactDelta invalidation or Session cache is added.

deletions: Per-candidate allocation of three projection-cache members inside r9v2BestCreationConsumerRoute

positiveOracles: Creation consumer full candidate proof coverage
negativeOracles: Different creation routes do not share a cache
withoutProduct and withProduct do not share a cache
No hidden input or provider label enters the cache identity

mustChange: implementation audit and performance evidence hashes

expectedWorkloadChange.projectedBehaviorPoolBuilds: decrease only for repeated identities inside one creation consumer route
expectedWorkloadChange.mechanicalBasisEvaluations: decrease with avoided repeated projected pools

rollbackCriteria: Any formal or replay hash mismatch
Candidate proof count or coverage changes
raid_control_heavy or raid_balanced P95 regression above 3% after repeated measurement
Any cache lifetime escapes the current creation consumer route
